acceptance.given: An optional dependency is absent and its declared fallback requires resolution.

oracle.expected: The fallback resolves successfully before the optional-absence path relies on it.
forbidden: The declared fallback cannot be resolved.
An unresolved fallback is executed as though it were valid.
oracle.observable: Dependency validation evidence records successful fallback resolution before fallback use.

acceptance.then: The declared fallback is resolved and available for the optional dependency path.
acceptance.when: Run the dependency validation check for the optional-absence path and inspect fallback resolution before fallback use.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the optional-fallback resolution selector with an unresolvable fallback and verify validation fails before fallback use.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate optional fallback resolvability before optional-path use.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing validator interfaces and valid declaration behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Absent optional dependency with fallback requiring resolution -> fallback resolved before use.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation rejects an unresolvable fallback and accepts only a resolved fallback.

acceptance.given: An optional dependency is absent and its fallback is being considered for execution or authorization.

oracle.expected: Authorization checks show that fallback execution does not authorize protected work.
forbidden: The fallback grants authorization to protected work.
Protected work proceeds solely because an optional dependency is absent and its fallback runs.
oracle.observable: The authorization-boundary check records denial or absent authorization for protected work through the fallback path.

acceptance.then: The optional fallback may run only without conferring protected-work authorization.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the authorization boundary while processing the optional-absence fallback path, before protected work is permitted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the fallback authorization-boundary selector with protected work requested and verify fallback-only authorization is rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Prevent optional fallback execution from satisfying protected-work authorization.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing authorization boundaries and validator result shape.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fallback selected -> protected work remains unauthorized without an independent authorization source.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The authorization check denies protected work when fallback is the sole authority.

acceptance.given: A dependency declaration is being created and its metadata is not yet established.

oracle.expected: The serialized declaration contains a non-empty dependency identity.
forbidden: A dependency is declared without an identity.
oracle.observable: Schema validation reads an explicit identity field or equivalent identity value.

acceptance.then: The dependency has an explicitly declared identity.
acceptance.when: Run declaration-schema validation on the dependency metadata artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run declaration-schema validation with identity omitted or empty and verify the artifact is rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an explicit identity in every dependency declaration.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing declaration schema and valid records compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declaration without identity -> declaration with explicit identity.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Schema validation passes only when a non-empty identity is present.

acceptance.given: A dependency declaration lacks a verified missing or mismatch behavior.

oracle.expected: The declaration defines deterministic outcomes for both missing and mismatched dependency conditions.
forbidden: Missing or mismatched dependency handling is unspecified.
Missing or mismatched dependency handling is nondeterministic.
oracle.observable: Validation exposes explicit deterministic handling for missing and mismatch cases and rejects absent or ambiguous handling.

acceptance.then: Deterministic missing and mismatch behavior is declared for the dependency.
acceptance.when: Run declaration-schema and semantic validation against missing-dependency and version-mismatch cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run dependency-behavior validation with missing or mismatch outcomes omitted, conflicting, or nondeterministic and verify rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require deterministic handling for missing and mismatched dependency conditions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing declaration format and valid deterministic policies.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declaration without deterministic missing/mismatch policy -> declaration with explicit deterministic outcomes.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation accepts a declaration only when both missing and mismatch handling are explicit and deterministic.
